title: Avoid repeated filesystem resolution under the shared Codex sessions lock
outcome: Avoid repeated filesystem resolution under the shared Codex sessions lock
acceptance: Each bounded approval check canonicalizes its unchanged workspace root once and reuses that result for target checks.
Approval path resolution avoids holding the runtime-wide shared sessions guard during filesystem I/O while retaining the existing runtime/turn/policy/Stop/read-only compare-and-apply fences.
Behavior tests preserve exact automatic responses, refusal notices and stale/Stop behavior without process inventories or synthetic resource stress.
